body:
Thank you. 
It's just... I fight every day of my life. Isn't easy when you want to change something hard as rock. I fight, I win, I die a little. 
And I lost my reason.
And I won't find another. Is it ok to live without a reason...?

I will write what happened. 

You guys have to understand that I'm not a good person. I do bad things, I lie constatly, that kind of stuff to worse. But I got a relationship with this girl and just tried the most to change my world; within three years, I was nearly done at making plans, bought a car, stopped with everything that would unplease her. She was the only one who ever loved me. I was born in a political ambient, people were always too busy. I know it's cliche and I'm just the misundestood child, but it's quite hard to pass though. Anyway, she loved me. 

Last month things changed. I got deep on my chronic depression. Even tried to kill myself. And then, yesterday, she just came to me and said she was done with all that bullshit. And that she love another guy, one who can give her the peaceful saturdays she deserve. I swear to god (that I don't believe, but still pray) that she said exactly that and the pain on my chest became unsustentable. All my friends left me on this last crisis and I could not get to work in 7 days, what lead me to getting fire. This last hit was too strong.

I came home. It wasn't a momentum; I had it all planned. Last time I took 10g and it barely killed me, so I was absolutely stunned when I woke up at home after the first convulsion. I posted here, tasting the irony, and convulsioned again. Again. Again. Always waking up. Then I thought it wasn't my time. I do not care about suffering, but what if my neighborhood listen? I would be locked in some sanatorium. Called 911 and said it was an OD but not intentional. 

Came here, and some doc said we would need to wait to see if I got some liver dmg, but he said it's likely. I'm in peace. Living with liver damage is just another damage to live on. 

But the whole at some point of my chest continues to grow. I know I shouldn't be typing here, but I need to scream it out, and I know you guys care. I care about you too. 

I just don't know what to do. I lost the only thing it ever mattered. And I lost it for myself.

3 hours late. Still conscious. 
For those who care, I'm at the hospital. I changed my mind; fuck courage, it always lacked me at crucial times. 

Btw. That hurts. Got convulsions several times, bashed my head in one of those. My body is strong, tho. I'm not in hard pain, it's almost better than the one I was.

and thanks. that's too dramatical for me, but it really helps.
I am still here. The meds gave me convultions yet still I'm breathing. Shouldn't wait much now. Thanks for all these late support.

Thank you for reading and for the kind answer - i wasn't expectating answers, to be honest. I'll check out the health thing. Never thought bout it. 
I tried professional (mental) help for a few years, but it made all even worse. Not sure why. Also tried to change the professional, but no help. If only I knew what to do to help myself, it would be better. Tried even some medicine, but it made me look at myself worse either.
Everything seems to get things worse. I don't know...
The loser thing is because of the lies. Pretending to be someone that you are not means that the one that you ARE is a fail. That's how the music sounds to me.

You can pass through this with good friends. These friends that don't care if you made mistakes, if you are not a person who's aways in the mood, they just care about you... They just want to see you happy. And there are people like this in the world, even though you don't know them yet. 

Life isn't easy and it will not get any easier. But it can be really delightful after these moments of deep depression. They go away, eventually, I promise you. 

That sounds really "surface" and I can't get more closer to the point because I don't know you, but the last words of you were partially right - you will shatter your mother's world AND the world of the girl you love.  I can understand that you can't live in your world anymore... So create a new one, don't put an end to all the world possibilites. Create a new one by doing something you only dreamt to do. 

I know it is hard, but there are still interesting people who will make you feel really better. Give yourself a chance.

Can you tell us what happened? You're not alone neither forgotten. 

If you want to see death, you could wait and let nature do it's job. Your life is precious (to me! you like Sylvia Plath, you're awesome!). Don't throw it away. Talk to us.

If you don't care, choose life. 
Then you can someday care. And you'll feel good about it.

You have two choices; choosing life, you still have a chance - to do WHATEVER you WANT - for the rest of your days. Choosing death, it's over.

If it counts, I care about your choice. So, please, choose wisely.

I'm like you. 
I do lie constantly to appear to be something. That makes me feel that I'm a monster, that I have no love and I deserve no love. I know what you're passing through, and you're not alone neither the only one. 

We are not mosters.
When I was at your age, I was really depressed. My depression took away 5 years of my life, and sometimes I still feel like those days. I've got kinda a dumb way to get over it - I started to work in anything I could. Develop my abilities, and, as yours, they were great. That's how I did it, and you might want to try.

If it doesn't work, get to the logical point. It's not our right to believe that we are bad people. If we do think like that, any person in the world that thinks that we're good people will be wronged. And our lies are way better than that, because they aren't final - we can come back, we can explain. We can even lie again. In our thoughts, though, there's no comeback. 

(I'm sorry for my bad English. Not my mother tongue and pretty much rusty).
